high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from a news or informational website. The content discusses the challenges faced by British fintech firms, specifically ClearBank, in obtaining banking licenses in the European Union (EU) due to Brexit. The text highlights that the U.K.'s decision to leave the EU has made it more difficult for these firms to expand operations within the bloc because they no longer have "passporting" rights, which allow companies to operate with a single U.K. license across all EU member states.
